skill.name: UI Design System
skill.description: Provides visual design rules for a dark, modern Physical AI Hub interface.
skill.summary: Apply a consistent dark theme, typography, components, animations, and CSS organization.
skill.author: AbdulSamad94

security_audit.summary: All 11 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around CSS values, animation names, and stylesheet paths. The single skill file contains design guidance only, with no commands, scripts, network activity, or prompt-injection text.

static_findings.snippet: - **Primary Accent**: `#2d7d6c` (Teal/Greenish) used in buttons and highlights.
- **Cards**: Glassmorphism effect (blur + transparency), rounded corners (`12px` or `16px`).
- **Inputs**: Rounded (`24px`), borderless or subtle border, focus rings.

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks delimit a CSS linear-gradient value in Markdown. This is documentation only and does not execute a shell command.

The backticks delimit a hexadecimal text color token in Markdown. This is static design documentation, not shell execution.
The backticks delimit a CSS rgba value in Markdown. The file contains no command invocation or executable code.
The backticks delimit CSS pixel values in a component guideline. They are not shell syntax in this Markdown context.
The backticks delimit a CSS border-radius value in documentation. No external command can run from this text.
The backticks delimit CSS transition examples in Markdown. The content is descriptive and has no execution mechanism.
The backticks delimit animation names in Markdown. They do not invoke a command or reference executable code.
The backticks identify a CSS file path in documentation. This is not a shell command and does not perform filesystem access.

content.value_statement: Teams can lose consistency when dark themes and component rules are undocumented. This skill provides practical visual rules for a modern Physical AI Hub interface.
actual_capabilities: Defines a dark color palette with background, accent, text, and border guidance.
Specifies Poppins typography weights and readability goals.
Describes visual treatment for buttons, cards, inputs, and dropdowns.
Recommends transitions and named animation patterns.
Identifies suggested locations for global, Docusaurus, and module CSS.
limitations: Does not provide production CSS or component source code.
Does not define responsive layouts, accessibility requirements, or contrast testing.
Focuses on a dark Physical AI visual direction rather than a general-purpose design system.
Does not include design tokens in a machine-readable format.

use_cases.title: Create a dashboard theme
use_cases.description: Apply the palette and component guidance when designing a dark operational dashboard.

use_cases.title: Review visual consistency
use_cases.description: Compare a product screen against the documented typography, color, and interaction rules.

use_cases.title: Organize stylesheet ownership
use_cases.description: Place global styles, documentation overrides, and component styles in the recommended CSS locations.

prompt_templates.title: Apply the core theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply this UI Design System to my page. Use the dark palette, Poppins typography, and rounded components.

prompt_templates.title: Design a form
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a settings form using this skill. Specify input styling, focus states, spacing, and button treatment.

prompt_templates.title: Review a component
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my dropdown against this UI Design System. List visual changes for colors, borders, motion, and shadows.

prompt_templates.title: Plan stylesheet structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan CSS ownership for a React and Docusaurus project using this skill. Separate global tokens, documentation overrides, and complex component modules.

output_examples.input: Design a dark login card using the system.
output: Dark gradient background with off-white text.
Teal primary action and subtle rgba borders.
Rounded card and inputs with a restrained transition.

output_examples.input: Where should styles for a complex chatbot component live?
output_examples.output: Use a CSS module for the chatbot. Keep shared variables in the global stylesheet.

best_practices: Use the defined accent and text colors consistently across interactive components.
Keep motion brief and use it to clarify state changes.
Store shared visual variables in global CSS and isolate complex component styles.
anti_patterns: Do not introduce unrelated bright colors that compete with the teal accent.
Do not apply long or excessive animations to routine interactions.
Do not place all component-specific styles in a global stylesheet.

faq.question: What visual style does this skill define?
faq.answer: It defines a dark, sleek, modern style for a Physical AI Hub.

faq.question: Which font does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends Poppins with weights from 400 through 700.

faq.question: Does it include component code?
faq.answer: No. It provides design guidance, not production component code.

faq.question: Which components does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers buttons, cards, inputs, and dropdowns.

faq.question: Does it support Docusaurus styles?
faq.answer: Yes. It identifies a custom CSS location for Docusaurus overrides.

faq.question: Does it provide accessibility requirements?
faq.answer: No. Teams should add accessibility and contrast requirements separately.
